faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Anna University JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at Anna University is 20th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class M.E./M.Tech or M.Sc. degree in relevant fields like Civil Engineering, Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Geology, or Computer Science Engineering, along with a valid NET/GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000 along with House Rent Allowance (HRA) of Rs. 3,700, totaling Rs. 40,700 per month.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete bio-data and required documents to the official email address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by Anna University.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: Anna University is recruiting for a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, followed by a Personal Interview, and finally Document Verification of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where is Anna University located?
faq.answer: Anna University is located in Tamil Nadu, with the specific recruitment for this JRF position being based in Nagercoil, Tamil Nadu, with pincode 629004.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity. The position of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) is offered on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required for the application?
faq.answer: You will need to attach self-attested copies of your educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with your application.
